svg.title: The Tolerance agent team
svg.desc: The plant owner talks to the Guide. The Guide runs the onboarding team (Document Reader, Connector Scout, Plant Modeler) and hands failures to the operations team (Diagnosis, Verifier, Remediation Planner, Warden, Sentinel). All agents can use Gemini on Vertex AI, and in Sentinel it only labels text; read the compiled plant model, and reach the machines only through the Cedar policy gateway, MCP connectors and probes.
svg.text: Nine agents on one gateway. Every agent can use Gemini. In Sentinel it only labels text. Nothing reaches a machine except through the policy gate.
